headline: onsemi Treo role calls for reusable digital-on-top verification of analog power and clock IP
fact: onsemi posted a Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer role for analog IP integrated into digital-on-top SoCs on its 65 nm Treo BCD platform. The position owns SystemVerilog and UVM testbenches, real-number and Verilog-A/AMS behavioral models for PLLs, LDOs, DC-DC converters, and oscillators, executable plans, assertions, coverage and checkers, regression debug, and model-validation strategies. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate, not proof of completed verification outcomes. A Spring 2027 internship listing dated September 29 describes possible assignments in Treo digital-on-top verification, assertions, coverage, behavioral models and exploration of AI-assisted design.

sources.summary: The official onsemi Oracle recruiting record exposes a May 19, 2026 posting timestamp and describes Treo digital-on-top AMS verification, reusable UVM environments, RNM/VAMS models, assertions, coverage, and model validation.
